newsitem.title: USA: Long Beach Financial sells over-allotment.
newsitem.headline: Long Beach Financial sells over-allotment.

text.p: Long Beach Financial Corp on Friday said the underwriting group in its recent initial public offer of stock has exercised its over-allotment option to purchase just under 2.5 million shares.
The purchase brings the number of shares sold in the offering to 25 million, representing 100 percent of the company's outstanding common stock.

Long Beach Financial's principal operating unit, Long Beach Mortgage Company, is a specialty finance company that originates, purchases and sells sub-prime residential mortgage loans secured by one-to-four family residences.
